standard.summary: 按预设比例把 backbone / text encoder 权重卸载到 CPU 内存，用吞吐换显存。旧的「优化器状态卸载」入口已并入该策略。
standard.effect: conservative=backbone 25% / TE 0%（最快）；balanced=50% / 25%（默认）；aggressive=75% / 50%（最省显存、最慢）。与 memory swap、vram_swap_to_ram、safe_fallback、多卡/DeepSpeed、Thunder 后端互斥；配合 torch.compile 时只允许 per_block 且关闭 fullgraph。
standard.whenToUse: 显存吃紧但还想保留单卡训练时先试 balanced；OOM 再升 aggressive。
standard.avoidWhen: 已经开了 swap_granularity / vram_swap_to_ram / safe_fallback 或多卡训练时不要再开，二者只能选一。

standard_en.summary: Offloads backbone / text-encoder weights to CPU memory at preset ratios, trading VRAM for throughput. The old optimizer-state offload entry has been merged into this profile.
standard_en.effect: conservative = backbone 25% / TE 0% (fastest); balanced = 50% / 25% (default); aggressive = 75% / 50% (lowest VRAM, slowest). Mutually exclusive with memory swap, vram_swap_to_ram, safe_fallback, multi-GPU/DeepSpeed and the Thunder backend; with torch.compile only per_block scope with fullgraph disabled is allowed.
standard_en.whenToUse: Try balanced first when VRAM is tight but you want single-GPU training; move up to aggressive on OOM.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not combine with swap_granularity / vram_swap_to_ram / safe_fallback or multi-GPU training -- pick one strategy.

advanced.principle: 按模块粒度而非优化器状态粒度做 CPU offload；比例预设由 module_offload_contract 定义，后端另有 custom 档可自行指定比例。
advanced.tradeoffs: 卸载的速度代价：CPU offload ≈ 2-5× 慢（取决于 PCIe 带宽）；disk offload ≈ 5-20× 慢（取决于 SSD 速度）。但对于原本显存不足无法训练的场景，这是唯一选择。

advanced_en.principle: Offload happens at module granularity rather than optimizer-state granularity; the ratio presets come from module_offload_contract, and the backend also offers a custom profile for manual ratios.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Offload's speed cost: CPU offload ≈ 2-5× slower (PCIe-bound); disk offload ≈ 5-20× slower (SSD-bound). But for setups that cannot train due to VRAM shortage, it is the only option.
